page.overview:
Who is Hope's Final Fantasy XIII battle and field exploration quotes?

Hope is a party member in Final Fantasy XIII. During battles and field exploration, he says various lines depending the action he takes and the point in the game the player is in.

This guy was a l'Cie too?! —Fight against Cid Raines.

Barthandelus! —Second fight against Barthandelus.

This is for you, Mom. —Second fight against Orphan.
